items.q: What does the Master Beauty Academy course cover?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy's 30-day Professional Beautician Course covers 9 categories: beauty & grooming (threading, waxing, brizzlin), facial treatments (incl. HydraFacial), hand & foot care, wellness & massage, hair care, hair cutting & styling, salon management, professional makeup, and advanced hair treatments (smoothening, hair botox).

items.q: How long is the beautician course at Master Beauty Academy?
items.a: The Professional Beautician Course runs for 30 days — an intensive hands-on programme covering all 9 categories. Morning and evening batches are available, and new intakes start regularly at both Hubli and Belagavi centres.

The Professional Beautician Course fee is ₹40,000 — flat and all-inclusive. There are no hidden add-ons for materials, kit or certification. Interest-free 2 or 3-month EMI plans are available — call our counsellor for your preferred schedule.

Yes. Master Beauty Academy issues a founder-signed Professional Beautician Certificate after course completion, signed by Co-Founder Priyanka Sakhe (LAPT London, Global Fame Awards 2023). It's accepted by salons across India.

Master Beauty Academy was founded by Anilkumar Sakhe (Co-Founder & CEO, 15+ years in business development) and Priyanka Sakhe (Co-Founder, recipient of the Award of Excellence in Makeup from LAPT London and Best Makeup Artist at the Global Fame Awards 2023, presented by Sonu Sood).

items.q: Does the course include makeup training?
items.a: Yes. The course includes a Basic Makeup Technician module — face preparation, product knowledge and everyday makeup application — taught personally by award-winning makeup artist Priyanka Sakhe. Advanced bridal-grade makeup is available as a specialisation after the foundation course.

items.q: Can I start my own salon after completing the course?
items.a: Yes. Category 7 of the course is dedicated to Salon Management Training — customer handling, salon operations, parlour management and professional grooming standards. Many of our 1,000+ graduates now run their own salons, with several earning up to ₹1 lakh per month.

Master Beauty Academy has two centres in North Karnataka: Hubli — Shop No. 34, Galaxy Mall, J C Nagar Main Road, New Hubli, 580020; and Belagavi — S N Pride Complex, Gondhali Galli, above New Takkekar Eye Hospital, Khade Bazar, Raviwar Peth, 590001.
